title: EMA Manipulation via Infrequent Claims
description: The EMA (Exponential Moving Average) smoothing mechanism can be manipulated by strategically timing claim transactions. Attackers can exploit the timing-dependent nature of EMA calculations to capture a disproportionate share of rewards.
impact: Attackers can capture an unfair share of rewards by timing their claims to manipulate the EMA calculation in their favor, effectively extracting value from other legitimate stakers.
attackPath: Monitor the EMA state and pending rewards
Wait for optimal timing when EMA is favorable
Execute claim at strategic intervals to maximize reward capture
Repeat to systematically extract excess rewards
recommendation: Implement time-weighted average calculations with minimum claim intervals or use a more manipulation-resistant smoothing algorithm.

metadata.downgradeReason: Requires specific timing and MEV knowledge to exploit effectively
